caption: PMJJBY gives Rs 2 lakh of life cover for Rs 436 a year, and PMSBY gives Rs 2 lakh of accident cover for Rs 20 a year. Together that is Rs 456 a year, about Rs 1.25 a day. Save this for later, and follow Rupee Sense for the next money basic.

pages.body: One covers your life, one covers accidents. Rs 456 a year together.

groups.items: Life cover. Rs 2 lakh if you die, any cause. Rs 436 a year. Age 18 to 50.
groups.title: PMJJBY

groups.items: Rs 2 lakh for accidental death or full disability, Rs 1 lakh partial. Rs 20 a year.
groups.title: PMSBY

pages.heading: Two covers.
pages.name: two

pages.body: One auto-debit a year from your bank account. No medical test.
pages.heading: What Rs 456 a year buys.
pages.name: cover

pages.body: Less than a cup of tea a day for up to Rs 4 lakh of cover.

pages.body: Ten minutes at your bank, once a year.
pages.heading: How to enrol.
items: Visit your bank or post office.
Ask for the PMJJBY and PMSBY forms.
The premium auto-debits once a year, around 1 June.
If the debit bounces, your cover lapses.
pages.name: enrol

pages.body: Rs 2 lakh is a floor, not enough cover for a family. Treat these as a start.
